activity.notes: Hiram I was king of Tyre. ATLAS uses the historical Kingdom of Tyre rather than treating Phoenicia as a single unitary state. Absolute reign dates are reconstructed, so c.970–c.936 BCE is stored with approximate certainty.

sources.title: Phoenicia — Encyclopaedia Britannica, 11th edition
sources.citation_text: The historical chronology places Hiram I's reign at Tyre approximately 970–936 BCE.

sources.title: Hiram of Tyre and Solomon — Society of Biblical Literature
sources.citation_text: The scholarly discussion treats the chronology of Hiram of Tyre as reconstructed and discusses dates around 969–935 BCE rather than directly attested exact boundaries.
